detail.title: Intex LED-G3231 32" HD Smart LED TV
detail.overview: Intex LED-G3231 is a 32-inch Smart TV The Intex LED-G3231 is a 32-inch Smart TV designed to offer a "Future of Entertainment" experience. It features a sleek, frameless design for pure visual elegance and is powered by Google TV, providing access to over 10,000+ apps including Netflix, Prime Video, and Disney+ Hotstar. With integrated DVB-S2 technology, users can enjoy lifetime free-to-air regional channels without a set-top box or monthly bills. The TV delivers immersive audio via 24W Dolby Audio down-firing speakers and vibrant visuals with an ADS Panel capable of 16.7 million colors.
